name: umbpanel-mcp
description: Connects Claude to the UmbPanel MCP server so an agent can manage a member's own UmbHost hosting — GreenStack Docker services, deploys and container debugging (logs, exec, files), Cloudflare DNS/zone/custom hostnames, databases, SFTP accounts and site files, email, registered domains, service sharing, support tickets and licences — acting as the signed-in member over OAuth.
